headline: OmniFysics-Nano-V2 reports gains on physical-understanding benchmarks
summary: A September 23 preprint describes OmniFysics-Nano-V2, a 4B-parameter omni-modal model trained with explicit physical supervision for image, video, audio, speech and text. The authors report results on named physical-understanding benchmarks that exceed the listed Qwen2.5-Omni-7B comparison scores on those tests. The paper reports mixed results across general multimodal benchmarks, and the embodied evaluation is simulator/engine-in-the-loop rather than physical robot deployment. No independent reproduction was performed.
